name: sentry_list_releases
description: List releases for the configured Sentry organization, newest first — useful for correlating a spike of errors with a recent deploy. Each release includes `version`, `shortVersion`, `dateCreated`, `dateReleased`, `projects`, and deploy/commit counts. Optional `query` filters by version substring (e.g. a release name or git sha).

query.description: Optional version substring to filter releases by.
